newsitem.title: USA: ACT Manufacturing to buy ESI unit for stock.
newsitem.headline: ACT Manufacturing to buy ESI unit for stock.

text.p: ACT Manufacturing Inc said Friday that it has agreed to acquire Electronic Systems International, a division of privately-held ESI Acquisition Corp, for 190,546 shares of its common stock.
ACT stock traded at 28-1/8 Friday morning.
The company said the acquisition will be accounted for by the purchase method of accounting, and is expected to close in June.

ACT makes printed circuit boards and other equipment for the computer, telecom and network industries. It had revenues of $226 million in 1996. ESI, which offers similar products and services, has annual sales of between $15 million and $20 million, said ACT.
